paragraphs: A turntable wrapper spins the pallet while the film feeds off a mast, and the operator does two things: puts the load on and takes it off. That division is what makes it semi automatic, and it is the right compromise for a warehouse that wraps dozens rather than hundreds a day.
The model is light at 44,821 polygons and 46,901 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $49 it suits warehouse and logistics visualisation, packaging equipment marketing, training material, industrial interiors, film backgrounds and game environments. On sale since 2021.

Grooming tools are designed around an animal that has not agreed to any of this. Quiet motors, rounded edges and blades that cannot reach skin are all consequences of the customer being unable to hold still or say when something hurts.
This is a collection listing rather than a single object, supplying the appliances as static pieces. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $44 the set suits pet product and retail visualisation, e-commerce imagery, veterinary and salon scenes, advertising, film set dressing and editorial illustration. On sale since 2026.

Foil number balloons turned birthdays into typography. A single digit floating at head height does what a banner used to do, and the whole party decoration industry reorganised itself around that in about a decade.
The set holds 47,112 polygons and 23,524 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, in multiple colours. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $44 it suits event and party visualisation, product and e-commerce imagery, advertising, interior scenes, motion graphics and editorial illustration. On sale since 2022.

The leaf shape is one of the most recognisable in botany, which is unusual for a plant whose actual structure most people have never looked at closely. Grown in a pot it is a domestic object, and the pot changes how the whole thing reads.
The model holds 72,643 polygons and 89,806 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 13 maps, 7 at 4096x4096 and 6 smaller. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $44 it suits botanical and horticultural visualisation, product and packaging imagery, education and documentary material, interior scenes and editorial illustration. On sale since 2026.

Three parachutes is not redundancy, it is arithmetic: a capsule can land safely on two, so the third exists so that losing one changes nothing. The staggered opening is what stops the shock of deployment tearing the whole cluster apart.
The model holds 372,372 polygons and 374,112 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, in orange. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $44 it suits space programme visualisation, news and documentary graphics, education and museum work, animation sequences, film and editorial illustration. On sale since 2024.

A raised bed of a single herb is what a market garden actually looks like: one crop, one bed, planted densely enough that nothing else gets light. The uniformity is the point, and it is what makes the bed readable from a distance.

The scene holds 600,064 polygons and 300,480 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, because a convincing bed means genuine plant geometry rather than cards. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $44 it suits garden and horticultural visualisation, food and agriculture presentation, landscape and architectural scenes, education material and editorial illustration. On sale since 2022.

Mounting ear defenders on the helmet rather than the head solved a compliance problem: separate muffs get taken off and left somewhere. Attached to the shell they swing up out of the way instead, which is the difference between protection and paperwork.
The model is very light at 12,796 polygons and 13,149 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $44 it suits industrial and construction visualisation, protective equipment marketing, training and safety material, character accessories, film props and game environments. On sale since 2022.

Condenser units are the part of air conditioning nobody designs and everybody sees. They hang on facades, sit on roofs and fill light wells, and a render of any warm climate city without them is immediately wrong.
This is a collection listing rather than a single object, supplying the outdoor units as static pieces. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.

At $42 the set suits architectural and urban visualisation, building services presentation, facade and rooftop scenes, film backgrounds, game environments and editorial illustration. On sale since 2024.

A first aid bag is organised for somebody who is frightened. Colour coded compartments, everything visible when it opens flat, and the most urgent items where a hand goes first without looking, because under pressure nobody reads labels.
This is a collection listing rather than a single object, supplying the bags as static pieces. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $42 the set suits medical and emergency services visualisation, safety and training material, equipment marketing, film props, game assets and editorial illustration. On sale since 2022.

A portobello is just a mature version of the mushroom sold as a button, left to open until the gills darken and the flavour concentrates. Sold loose in a basket rather than wrapped, they are presented as produce rather than as an ingredient.
The model is very light at 11,695 polygons and 12,017 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, supplying the mushrooms in the basket. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $41 it suits food and grocery visualisation, market and kitchen scenes, packaging and menu imagery, advertising, film set dressing and editorial illustration. On sale since 2025.

The flat panelled truck is already almost a cartoon, which makes it unusually easy to stylise: the shape is made of straight lines, so exaggerating it means changing proportions rather than simplifying surfaces.
The model is extremely light at 4,710 polygons and 4,742 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, and carries StemCell certification. A rigged build is offered separately.
At $41 it suits animation and motion graphics, children's media, game vehicles, advertising, infographic and editorial illustration. On sale since 2025.

The mid century stiletto changed how a woman walked, deliberately. The heel is placed further back than balance wants, which forces the posture the shoes were designed to produce, and the whole silhouette of the era followed from that one decision.
The model holds 138,238 polygons and 185,002 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, which is enough for close product work. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $41 it suits footwear and fashion visualisation, e-commerce and catalogue imagery, period film costume, advertising, character accessories and editorial illustration. On sale since 2025.

The intermediate bulk container standardised liquid logistics the way the shipping container standardised everything else. A fixed footprint that matches a pallet, a cage that stacks, and a valve at the bottom because gravity is free.
The model is light at 37,173 polygons and 18,883 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, in stainless steel. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $39 it suits industrial and logistics visualisation, chemical and food processing scenes, equipment marketing, warehouse interiors, film backgrounds and game environments. On sale since 2024.

A long range acoustic device is a directional loudspeaker, and the direction is the whole technology. It projects a beam of sound rather than a field, which means it can be heard clearly at a distance where a normal speaker would be lost entirely.
The model holds 170,940 polygons and 90,091 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $39 it suits security and public safety visualisation, maritime and infrastructure presentation, equipment marketing, news graphics, film props and game environments. On sale since 2023.
